Module 1: Complete Authentication & Token Lifecycles

File: 01_Master_Auth_Architecture_and_Token_Flows.md * OAuth2 + PKCE End-to-End Implementation: Bulletproof authorization code flows for Single Page Apps (SPAs), mobile clients, and machine-to-machine microservices. * Refresh Token Rotation (RTR) Engine: State-of-the-art token family tracking in Redis that instantly revokes the entire token family upon detecting replay attempts. * Stateless vs. Stateful JWT Strategies: Asymmetric key signing (RS256/Ed25519), JWKS rotation pipelines, and ultra-low-latency distributed revocation blacklists. * Zero-Trust Session Invalidation: Instant multi-device logout flows, session hijacking mitigations, and strict __Host- cookie configurations with complete CSRF immunity.

Module 2: Distributed Rate Limiting, DDoS & Bot Defense Blueprints

File: 02_Distributed_Rate_Limiting_and_Gateway_Rules.md * 20+ Production Rate-Limiting Recipes: Tiered limiters designed for public endpoints, authenticated users, payment checkouts, and high-volume webhooks. * Atomic Sliding-Window Redis Scripts: Fully tested, race-condition-free Lua scripts for sub-millisecond precision throttling without memory leaks. * Edge WAF & Cloudflare Worker Rules: Copy-paste Edge Worker scripts to filter malicious scrapers, credential stuffers, and layer 7 floods before they hit your origin. * IP Reputation & Dynamic Tarpitting: Anomaly detection heuristics that progressively slow down suspicious clients instead of instantly failing, trapping attackers in tarpits.

Module 3: OWASP API Top 10 Patches, SSRF Shielding & Payload Hardening

File: 03_OWASP_API_Top_10_Mitigations_and_Middleware.md * BOLA / IDOR Eradication Middleware: Generic, policy-based object authorization middleware that verifies record ownership at the data-access layer. * Mass Assignment & Strict Schema Validators: Runtime payload stripping rules that prevent unauthorized privilege escalation and attribute injection. * SSRF Shielding for Webhook Engines: Comprehensive DNS resolution checks, private IP range blocks (RFC 1918/link-local), and egress proxy configurations. * GraphQL & REST Payload Defense: Depth-limiting middleware, circular reference breakers, ReDoS-safe regex patterns, and airtight CORS headers.
